scope: bounded offline review only; no repo or service writes

local_helpers.merchant_probe: Uses GCP_SA_KEY and MERCHANT_ID. GETs Merchant accounts v1/v1beta and Shopping Content authinfo. It does not GET individual products or join product_id to product_data_source. It also has a POST developerRegistration:registerGcp when REGISTRIEREN=true.
local_helpers.merchant_feed: Uses Shopify credentials (SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID + SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET or SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN, plus SHOPIFY_SHOP). Shopify GraphQL query reads products according to FEED_QUERY (default status:active or status:active AND tag:fortura), paginates in SCAN-bounded pages, reads variants(first:1), and builds an offline XML feed. It sets Google feed id from Shopify handle, maps price/link/image/availability, and writes OUT locally. It is not a Merchant Center product or source read; it does not establish which current source submits any CSV offer.
local_helpers.gmc_feed_item: Pure XML item builder; product id is p.id or p.sku or p.handle; writes standard feed fields (link, image_link, availability, price, etc.); no external calls or Merchant source lookup.
local_helpers.merchant_versand: Uses GCP_SA_KEY. GETs Merchant account list and shippingSettings; selects the sole visible account only if exactly one is returned. It can POST shippingSettings:insert. MODUS defaults to pruefen; MODUS=schreiben enables insert, and MODUS=zurueck triggers removal path followed by an insert. No interactive confirmation gate is present in that code path. This is shipping-only, not product-source lookup.
local_helpers.workflow: merchant-probe workflow has workflow_dispatch and a push trigger scoped to branch claude/merchant-probe-1111 and two paths. Its registrieren input defaults false but supplies REGISTRIEREN to the probe, so the workflow is not intrinsically read-only despite its title. It passes the GCP_SA_KEY GitHub secret by name only.
local_helpers.safe_existing_product_source_route: No existing direct GMC Product get or safe product_id-to-source lookup among these paths. Shopify feed generation cannot substitute for a Merchant read or bypass the Windsor timeout because it reads Shopify and may produce a locally generated feed only.
